Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: City Outskirts]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinecityoutskirts-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinecityoutskirts.jpg tatooinecityoutskirts.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010809060150/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinecityoutskirts.jpg Internet Archive], 9 August 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: d866def4e001c5fbb205527a6ffea4f6cd864c0d32ebea349e3bd5fb49ad7ce1.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 90 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (4 pixel rows of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinecityoutskirts.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
